name: @ritojs/core
description: Rust-backed EPUB reader core with browser package bindings

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ritojs/core-wasm build && tsdown && node scripts/copy-wasm-artifact.mjs && node scripts/verify-worker-entry.mjs
scripts.build:reference: tsdown src/reference/index.ts src/compatibility/advanced.ts src/compatibility/web.ts --format esm --out-dir .output/reference-build --tsconfig tsconfig.build.json --sourcemap false --no-dts --logLevel warn
scripts.diagnose:render: pnpm --filter @ritojs/core-wasm build && pnpm run build && pnpm run build:reference && node scripts/render-diagnostic-case.mjs
scripts.diagnose:reader-parity: pnpm --filter @ritojs/core-wasm build && pnpm run build && pnpm run build:reference && RITO_DIAG_ENGINE=both node scripts/render-diagnostic-case.mjs
scripts.fixtures:rust:check: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:reference && RITO_RUST_FIXTURE_CHECK=1 node scripts/export-rust-fixtures.mjs
scripts.fixtures:rust:export: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:reference && node scripts/export-rust-fixtures.mjs
scripts.test:golden:pixel: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:reference && RITO_PIXEL_GOLDEN=1 playwright test -c playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:golden:pixel:review: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:reference && RITO_PIXEL_GOLDEN=1 RITO_PIXEL_REVIEW=1 playwright test -c playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:golden:pixel:update: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:reference && RITO_PIXEL_GOLDEN=1 RITO_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 playwright test -c playwright.config.ts
